machine: gb10 (see MACHINES.md; shared box - co-tenant organs run throughout: STT/TTS/embedding/recall services resident on the GPU and CPUs; all timed cells nice -n 19)
gpu: NVIDIA GB10 (compute_121, 121.6 GiB unified), co-tenant GPU residency ~43 GiB during runs

pinning.single_core_cells: taskset -c 7 (one Cortex-X925 core): geolog-shared, expand, staged-GLC recheck, certified-checker census, gym receipts, circuits recheck
pinning.lean_route_glc: driver-pinned cpu 15 (Cortex-X925), matching the incumbent receipt's protocol

glc-check.note: built from a pinned checkout at QTSL_REV 43cd608130c2c805a5fbd5e416303daf025eb7dc; byte-identical to the RESEAL-5.1.md provenance pin

flcheck.note: gym receipts; built in this branch's tree

qtslab.note: certified checker; census.gb10.tsv sidecar provenance.gb10.json carries its full identity

protocol: 10 repeats per benchmark (+1 flagged warmup on produce); serial, one timed process at a time; expand 1 pass per container; GPU device init OOM'd twice under co-tenant load (CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at init, attempts ~10 min apart) and succeeded on the third attempt - produce-gpu.json is that successful full run
spread_rule: (max-min)/median > 0.25 flagged; geolog-shared flagged 3 sub-80ms cells (faulty_varying 0.31, faulty_varying__last_step 0.35, repulse100 0.38); one quiet-moment re-run was attempted and came back noisier (worst 2.9, a co-tenant burst), so the FIRST set shipped - medians agree within ~5% across both sets; no other cell flagged
